youtube_title: WhatsApp Profit Group With Daily Screenshots? SEBI Says It's a Trap | Scam of the Week #14 #Shorts
youtube_description:
SCAM OF THE WEEK #14. An unknown number adds you to a WhatsApp 'profit' group full of screenshots. Join in or leave? Comment A or B!
Answer: B. In October 2026 SEBI warned that profit claims in invite-only groups may be deliberately planted. Don't open accounts on apps they push and don't send money. A new invite from a new number after a group is shut is also a red flag. Deal only with SEBI-registered intermediaries (check on SEBI's website). Cyber fraud helpline: 1930.
Source: SEBI press release, 22 Oct 2026.
Education only, not financial advice.
